command:
set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; state(){ adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1; }; adb -s "$SERIAL" get-state | grep -qx device; test "$(state)" = "0"; adb -s "$SERIAL" install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk >/tmp/phase2-downlink-v3-install.log; cat /tmp/phase2-downlink-v3-install.log; APK=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge | cut -d: -f2 | head -n1); test -n "$APK"; echo '=== open-abort v3 ==='; A=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell "CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.DownlinkPipeProbe open-abort-offcall"); printf '%s
' "$A"; printf '%s
' "$A" | grep -q 'probe=downlink-pipe-v3'; printf '%s
' "$A" | grep -q 'context_package=android'; printf '%s
' "$A" | grep -q 'audio_mode=0'; printf '%s
' "$A" | grep -q 'read_end_acquired=true'; printf '%s
' "$A" | grep -q 'terminated_after_abort=true'; printf '%s
' "$A" | grep -q 'aborted_after_abort=true'; echo '=== start-offcall v3 ==='; B=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell "CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.DownlinkPipeProbe start-offcall"); printf '%s
' "$B"; printf '%s
' "$B" | grep -q 'probe=downlink-pipe-v3'; printf '%s
' "$B" | grep -q 'context_package=android'; printf '%s
' "$B" | grep -q 'audio_mode=0'; printf '%s
' "$B" | grep -q 'offcall_start_rejected=true'; printf '%s
' "$B" | grep -q 'terminated_after_start_failure=true'; printf '%s
' "$B" | grep -q 'terminal_failure_present=true'; test "$(state)" = "0"; rm -f /tmp/phase2-downlink-v3-install.log; echo phase2_downlink_deferred_context_offcall_ok=true
